sections.text:
Ability Power 120. Damages all enemies with magic wind damage. Chance to hit 3-6 times.
Added effect: Removes buffs from target and removes debuffs from all allies.
 Level bonus: Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level
[Additional Unison Effect] Reduces ATK/MATK of all enemies by 50% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the DEF and MDEF of all allies by 50% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Heals the HP of all allies with 10% of max HP every 5 seconds for 20 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Reduces the physical and magic damage taken by all allies by 30% for 40 seconds.
